title: ‘Crazy’ Woman Bites a Cop and Steals His Police Cruiser
description:
Bodycam footage shows a Michigan woman allegedly stealing a police car after getting arrested on August 8. The Michigan State Police said Cortney Morey was accused of assaulting a man. When officers spoke with Cortney, things got out of hand quickly. Eventually, Morey finds herself in the back of a cop car but she has an idea that takes police on a 120 mph chase. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
